name: B10-0140/2024 (PPE) – People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union and its member states to back Taiwan more openly. It rejects China's claim that a 1971 United Nations resolution says Taiwan belongs to China. It condemns China's recent large military drills around Taiwan and asks the European Union to support Taiwan joining bodies like the World Health Organization. It also wants closer trade and investment talks with Taiwan and more European visits there. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; the Parliament asks the European Union and member states to act.
- **Who it affects:** Taiwan, China, European Union governments and companies trading with Taiwan.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and both governments; they decide whether to act.
